description: Project Intelligence data schema for page generation. Fill this in, the generator builds the page.

example.about: I built this world for Shawn — his front door on NayaNET, where intelligence compounds and everybody wins, and everything he does lives here.
example.mission: Build NayaNET — the intelligent highway for the AI age.
example.name: Shawn
example.vision: A world where intelligence compounds and everybody wins.

about.description: About — who this world is for and what lives in it, in Naya's voice

build_receipt.description: The Factory build receipt — what was built, when, and what it looks like now. Written back to PI on every build.

build_url.description: The live URL of the built world

built_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC of the last Factory build

cover.description: Cover image URL (optional, defaults to DNA gradient)

goal.description: The goal — what this world is trying to achieve

mission.description: The mission — why this world exists

name.description: The world name (person, business, space, or smart-access name)

project_id.description: The project key — the contract key the flow carries and the processor reads PI by. A project IS a page.

template.description: The Factory template this world was built from

type.description: World type — determines which sections show

vision.description: The vision — what this page is becoming (shows in hero, 20px nutshell)
